name: issue-creator/basic
prompt: Create a bug issue for mobile login redirect loop

grade.label: branch name from subject artifact passes idd-lint
gh issue create returned a URL
created issue is read back before reporting completion

criteria: Opening text states completion status and the created issue number.
Observed write verification is separate from inferred classification and untested bug reproduction.
Issue URL and saved verification.json support the reported title/body checks.
The report says No approval needed and names remaining user actions.
human_review.feedback: Record each reviewer answer; absent, blank, or nonresponsive feedback leaves understanding unconfirmed.
human_review.scope: This deterministic stand-in tests a report fixture, not live agent behavior. Apply these criteria to actual agent outputs in behavioral evaluations.
